sentences.zh: 25%丙部子錄，其類十七：一曰儒家類，二曰道家類，三曰法家類，四曰名家類，五曰墨家類，六曰縱橫家類，七曰雜家類，八曰農家類，九曰小說類，十曰天文類，十一曰曆算類，十二曰兵書類，十三曰五行類，十四曰雜藝術類，十五曰類書類，十六曰明堂經脉類，十七曰醫術類。

translations.literal: In the Bing section, the Catalog of Masters has seventeen categories: first, the Confucian category; second, the Daoist category; third, the Legalist category; fourth, the School-of-Names category; fifth, the Mohist category; sixth, the Coalitionist category; seventh, the Eclectic category; eighth, the Agrarian category; ninth, the Fiction category; tenth, the Astronomy category; eleventh, the Calendar and Computation category; twelfth, the Military Writings category; thirteenth, the Five Phases category; fourteenth, the Miscellaneous Arts category; fifteenth, the Encyclopedic Compilations category; sixteenth, the Hall of Enlightenment and Meridians category; seventeenth, the Medical Arts category.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Bing division, the Masters register lists seventeen categories: Confucian, Daoist, Legalist, School-of-Names, Mohist, Coalitionist, Eclectic, Agrarian, fiction, astronomy, calendrics and mathematics, military writings, five phases, miscellaneous arts, encyclopedic compilations, hall-of-enlightenment and meridian texts, and medical arts.

sentences.zh: 凡著錄六百九家，九百六十七部，一萬七千一百五十二卷；

translations.literal: Of registered entries in all, six hundred nine authors, nine hundred sixty-seven titles, seventeen thousand one hundred fifty-two scrolls;
translations.idiomatic: Registered works total 609 authors, 967 titles, and 17,152 scrolls;

sentences.zh: 不著錄五百七家，五千六百一十五卷。

translations.literal: Not registered: five hundred seven authors, five thousand six hundred fifteen scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: unregistered entries add 507 authors and 5,615 scrolls.

sentences.zh: 晏子春秋七卷晏嬰。

translations.literal: Spring and Autumn Annals of Master Yan, seven scrolls — Yan Ying.
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals of Master Yan in seven scrolls, by Yan Ying.

sentences.zh: 曾子二卷曾參。

translations.literal: Master Zeng, two scrolls — Zeng Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Master Zeng in two scrolls, by Zeng Shen.

sentences.zh: 子思子七卷孔伋。

translations.literal: Master Zisi, seven scrolls — Kong Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Master Zisi in seven scrolls, by Kong Ji (Zisi).

sentences.zh: 公孫尼子一卷趙岐注孟子十四卷孟軻。

translations.literal: Gongsun Ni, one scroll; Zhao Qi annotated Mencius, fourteen scrolls — Meng Ke.
translations.idiomatic: Master Gongsun Ni in one scroll; Mencius in fourteen scrolls with Zhao Qi's commentary, by Meng Ke.

sentences.zh: 劉熙注孟子七卷鄭玄注孟子七卷綦毋邃注孟子七卷荀卿子十二卷荀況。

translations.literal: Liu Xi annotated Mencius, seven scrolls; Zheng Xuan annotated Mencius, seven scrolls; Qimu Sui annotated Mencius, seven scrolls; Master Xunzi, twelve scrolls — Xun Kuang.
translations.idiomatic: Mencius in seven scrolls (Liu Xi); Mencius in seven scrolls (Zheng Xuan); Mencius in seven scrolls (Qimu Sui); Master Xunzi in twelve scrolls, by Xun Kuang.

sentences.zh: 董子一卷董無心。

translations.literal: Master Dong, one scroll — Dong Wuxin.
translations.idiomatic: Master Dong in one scroll, by Dong Wuxin.

sentences.zh: 魯連子一卷魯仲連。

translations.literal: Master Lu Lian, one scroll — Lu Zhonglian.
translations.idiomatic: Master Lu Lian in one scroll, by Lu Zhonglian.

sentences.zh: 陸賈新語二卷賈誼新書十卷桓寬鹽鐵論十卷劉向新序三十卷又說苑三十卷揚子法言六卷揚雄。

translations.literal: Lu Jia's New Discourses, two scrolls; Jia Yi's New Writings, ten scrolls; Huan Kuan's Discourses on Salt and Iron, ten scrolls; Liu Xiang's New Arrangements, thirty scrolls; also Garden of Stories, thirty scrolls; Master Yang's Exemplary Sayings, six scrolls — Yang Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: New Discourses by Lu Jia in two scrolls; New Writings by Jia Yi in ten scrolls; Discourses on Salt and Iron by Huan Kuan in ten scrolls; New Arrangements and Garden of Stories by Liu Xiang, thirty scrolls each; Exemplary Sayings by Master Yang in six scrolls, by Yang Xiong.

translations.literal: Song Zhong annotated Exemplary Sayings, ten scrolls; Li Gui annotated Exemplary Sayings, three scrolls; Lu Ji annotated Master Yang's Supreme Mystery Classic, twelve scrolls; Yu Fan annotated Supreme Mystery Classic, fourteen scrolls; Fan Wang annotated Supreme Mystery Classic, twelve scrolls; Song Zhongfu annotated Supreme Mystery Classic, twelve scrolls; Cai Wenshao annotated Supreme Mystery Classic, ten scrolls; Master Huan's New Discourses, seventeen scrolls — Huan Tan.
translations.idiomatic: Exemplary Sayings in ten scrolls (Song Zhong); Exemplary Sayings in three scrolls (Li Gui); Supreme Mystery Classic in twelve scrolls (Lu Ji); Supreme Mystery Classic in fourteen scrolls (Yu Fan); Supreme Mystery Classic in twelve scrolls (Fan Wang); Supreme Mystery Classic in twelve scrolls (Song Zhongfu); Supreme Mystery Classic in ten scrolls (Cai Wenshao); New Discourses by Master Huan in seventeen scrolls, by Huan Tan.

sentences.zh: 王符潛夫論十卷仲長子昌言十卷仲長統。

translations.literal: Wang Fu's Comments of a Recluse, ten scrolls; Zhongchang Tong's Master Zhongchang's Words, ten scrolls — Zhongchang Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Comments of a Recluse by Wang Fu in ten scrolls; Master Zhongchang's Words in ten scrolls, by Zhongchang Tong.

sentences.zh: 荀悅申鑒五卷魏子三卷魏朗。

translations.literal: Xun Yue's Extended Reflections, five scrolls; Master Wei, three scrolls — Wei Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Extended Reflections by Xun Yue in five scrolls; Master Wei in three scrolls, by Wei Lang.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝典論五卷徐氏中論六卷徐幹。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen of Wei's Authoritative Discourses, five scrolls; Master Xu's Balanced Discourses, six scrolls — Xu Gan.
translations.idiomatic: Authoritative Discourses by Emperor Wen of Wei in five scrolls; Balanced Discourses by Master Xu in six scrolls, by Xu Gan.

translations.literal: Wang Can's Collected Discourses on Removing Punitive Expeditions, three scrolls; Wang Su's Political Discourses, ten scrolls; Master Du's Substantive Discourses, four scrolls — Du Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Collected Discourses on Removing Punitive Expeditions by Wang Can in three scrolls; Political Discourses by Wang Su in ten scrolls; Substantive Discourses by Master Du in four scrolls, by Du Shu.

sentences.zh: 顧子新論五卷顧譚。

translations.literal: Master Gu's New Discourses, five scrolls — Gu Tan.
translations.idiomatic: New Discourses by Master Gu in five scrolls, by Gu Tan.

sentences.zh: 文禮通語十卷殷興續。

translations.literal: Comprehensive Sayings of Wen and Li, ten scrolls — Yin Xingxu.
translations.idiomatic: Comprehensive Sayings of Wen and Li in ten scrolls, by Yin Xingxu.

sentences.zh: 諸葛亮集誡二卷陸景典訓十卷譙子法訓八卷又五教五卷譙周。

translations.literal: Zhuge Liang's Collected Admonitions, two scrolls; Lu Jing's Canonical Instructions, ten scrolls; Master Qiao's Legal Instructions, eight scrolls; also Five Teachings, five scrolls — Qiao Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Collected Admonitions by Zhuge Liang in two scrolls; Canonical Instructions by Lu Jing in ten scrolls; Legal Instructions and Five Teachings by Master Qiao in eight and five scrolls, by Qiao Zhou.

sentences.zh: 王嬰古今通論三卷周生烈子五卷袁子正論二十卷又正書二十五卷袁準。

translations.literal: Wang Ying's Comprehensive Discourse Through Past and Present, three scrolls; Master Zhou Shenglie, five scrolls; Master Yuan's Correct Discourses, twenty scrolls; also Correct Writings, twenty-five scrolls — Yuan Zhun.
translations.idiomatic: Comprehensive Discourse Through Past and Present by Wang Ying in three scrolls; Master Zhou Shenglie in five scrolls; Correct Discourses and Correct Writings by Master Yuan in twenty and twenty-five scrolls, by Yuan Zhun.

sentences.zh: 孫氏成敗志三卷孫毓。

translations.literal: Master Sun's Records of Success and Failure, three scrolls — Sun Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Records of Success and Failure by Master Sun in three scrolls, by Sun Yu.

sentences.zh: 夏侯湛新論十卷楊泉物理論十六卷又太元經十四卷劉緝注。

translations.literal: Xiahou Zhan's New Discourses, ten scrolls; Yang Quan's Discourse on Physical Principles, sixteen scrolls; also Supreme Mystery Classic, fourteen scrolls — Liu Ji annotated.
translations.idiomatic: New Discourses by Xiahou Zhan in ten scrolls; Discourse on Physical Principles by Yang Quan in sixteen scrolls; Supreme Mystery Classic in fourteen scrolls with Liu Ji's commentary.

sentences.zh: 華譚新論十卷虞喜志林新書二十卷又後林新書十卷顧子義訓十卷顧夷。

translations.literal: Hua Tan's New Discourses, ten scrolls; Yu Xi's Forest of Records, New Writings, twenty scrolls; also Later Forest of Records, New Writings, ten scrolls; Master Gu's Righteous Instructions, ten scrolls — Gu Yi.
translations.idiomatic: New Discourses by Hua Tan in ten scrolls; Forest of Records and Later Forest of Records by Yu Xi in twenty and ten scrolls; Righteous Instructions by Master Gu in ten scrolls, by Gu Yi.

sentences.zh: 蔡洪清化經十卷干寶正言十卷又立言十卷蔡韶閎論二卷呂竦要覽五卷周捨正覽六卷劉徽魯史欹器圖一卷綦毋氏誡林三卷顏氏家訓七卷顏之推。

translations.literal: Cai Hong's Classic of Pure Transformation, ten scrolls; Gan Bao's Correct Words, ten scrolls; also Establishing Words, ten scrolls; Cai Shao's Broad Discourses, two scrolls; Lü Song's Essential Survey, five scrolls; Zhou She's Correct Survey, six scrolls; Liu Hui's Lu History Tilted-Vessel Diagram, one scroll; Qimu clan's Admonition Forest, three scrolls; Yan clan's Family Instructions, seven scrolls — Yan Zhitui.
translations.idiomatic: Classic of Pure Transformation by Cai Hong in ten scrolls; Correct Words and Establishing Words by Gan Bao in ten scrolls each; Broad Discourses by Cai Shao in two scrolls; Essential Survey by Lü Song in five scrolls; Correct Survey by Zhou She in six scrolls; Lu History Tilted-Vessel Diagram by Liu Hui in one scroll; Admonition Forest by the Qimu clan in three scrolls; Family Instructions by the Yan clan in seven scrolls, by Yan Zhitui.

sentences.zh: 李穆叔典言四卷王滂百里昌言二卷崔子至言六卷崔靈童。

translations.literal: Li Mushu's Authoritative Sayings, four scrolls; Wang Pang's Hundred-Li Broad Words, two scrolls; Master Cui's Ultimate Sayings, six scrolls — Cui Lingtong.
translations.idiomatic: Authoritative Sayings by Li Mushu in four scrolls; Hundred-Li Broad Words by Wang Pang in two scrolls; Ultimate Sayings by Master Cui in six scrolls, by Cui Lingtong.
